title: Asserting Too Early: The Quiet Source of Flaky Playwright Tests
titleSr: Prerana provjera: tihi izvor nestabilnih Playwright testova
excerpt: Many flaky Playwright tests aren't slow, they check too early. How instant checks and missing awaits cause false failures and false passes.
excerptSr: Mnogi nestabilni Playwright testovi nisu spori, nego provjeravaju prerano. Kako trenutne provjere i zaboravljeni await uzrokuju lažne padove i lažne prolaze.

title: Why Maestro Deserves a Spot in Your Web Testing Toolkit
titleSr: Zašto Maestro zaslužuje mjesto u vašem alatu za testiranje web aplikacija
excerpt: Maestro is known as a mobile UI testing tool, but its browser support quietly closes the gap with web testing. Here's why I reach for it, and how to write your first flow.
excerptSr: Maestro je poznat kao alat za testiranje mobilnih aplikacija, ali podrška za pretraživač tiho zatvara jaz prema web testiranju. Evo zašto ga koristim, i kako napisati svoj prvi tok.
